page.title: Admin Settings
page.description: Configure administrative preferences and default platform behavior.

fields.allowSelfRegistrationEnabled: Enabled: users can create new accounts.
fields.allowSelfRegistrationDisabled: Disabled: only admins can add users.
fields.requireEmailVerificationEnabled: Enabled: new users must verify email.
fields.sendSupportTicketConfirmationEmailEnable: Enabled: users get an acknowledgment email after submitting a support ticket.
fields.sendSupportTicketConfirmationEmailDisabl: Disabled: no acknowledgment email is sent after ticket submission.
fields.sendFeedbackConfirmationEmailEnabled: Enabled: users get an acknowledgment email after submitting feedback.
fields.sendFeedbackConfirmationEmailDisabled: Disabled: no acknowledgment email is sent after feedback submission.
fields.sendNewsletterWelcomeEmailEnabled: Enabled: when newsletter delivery is configured, new and reactivated subscribers receive a branded welcome email (Resend).
fields.sendNewsletterWelcomeEmailDisabled: Disabled: no welcome email is sent on subscribe.
fields.forceSingleActiveSessionEnabled: Enabled: one active session per user.
fields.forceSingleActiveSessionDisabled: Disabled: users can stay signed in on multiple devices.
fields.workingDaysDescription: Select the active days of the week when the institute operates.
fields.workingDaysMinError: Please select at least one working day.
